verdict.rationale: Gitea's first-party docs list milestones and due dates among its built-in issue-tracking features, so a developer can group issues into milestones and set due dates. The evidence is only a one-line feature list, and it ties due dates to issues rather than explicitly to milestones. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of due dates on milestones themselves, in-depth docs on milestone creation and management (progress, closing), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group issues into milestones with due dates

citations.quote: Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.
